evidence.reason: The reviews branch of the fake returns the complete concatenated page stream regardless of whether `--paginate` is present. `_apply_reviews_jq` is explicitly documented as modelling real `gh api --jq` over the recorded response, and real `gh api` only retrieves later pages when pagination is requested. So the fake cannot distinguish a dropped `--paginate` flag and can let a pagination regression pass unnoticed, undermining the fail-closed treatment of truncated review data. The suggested guard is a small test-harness correctness fix. The additional named assertion is test hardening, but the underlying fake-fidelity defect is valid on the supplied code.
